coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Jaipur Settlement Department khasra and JDA scheme-plot layers, with actual public geometry extent unverified. Separate state Bhu-Naksha rural reports are not used to infer urban coverage.

technicalBlocker: Advertised official parcel services are currently unreachable from both checked networks. Certificate bypass cannot cure a pre-TLS TCP timeout.
remainingUncertainty: No public, nonempty parcel polygon associated with the exact WUP target point was verified.
nextStep: Retry the exact public parcel services when reachable, following the portal’s ordinary anonymous bootstrap if required, then request only geometry and parcel identifiers in a small Jaipur bbox. Confirm location, polygon quality and fresh identity resolution before enabling a provider.

registryBasis: The official Rajasthan Urban GIS Portal explicitly attributes khasra/village boundaries to the Settlement Department and advertises Jaipur Settlement_JDA and JDA_Plots services. City-scoped cadastral map publication is documented; live geometry access is not verified.
